# Field reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_reference.py from src/asb_schema/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

This page lists every class, slot and enumeration of the seven LinkML files of ASB Schema, one section per file. It is generated from `src/asb_schema/*.yaml` by `scripts/gen_reference.py`, and CI checks that it matches the sources.

## Reading this page

- Each class has the anchor `#class-<ClassName>` and each enumeration the anchor `#enum-<EnumName>`; each file section has the anchor `#file-<file name>`.
- The table of a class lists the slots named under its `slots` key, then its inline attributes.
- Range is the declared range, or `string` when none is declared. Cardinality reads `1` (required), `0..1` (optional), `1..*` (required list) or `0..*` (optional list).
- Notes give the serialized alias, pattern, bounds, `slot_uri`, annotations (including `importance`) and ontology mappings.
- Descriptions are copied from the sources. An em-dash becomes a colon, an en-dash between numbers becomes "to", a pointer to an unpublished design note is left out, and the name of the reference pipeline is written as "Reference pipeline".
- Slot names are global in LinkML: loading `asb.yaml` merges slots that share a name across files. Validate each artifact against its own file; see [Conformance](conformance.md).

## asb.yaml { #file-asb }

<div class="asb-spec-meta"> <span class="asb-badge asb-badge--version">asb.yaml 0.2.0</span> <code>https://w3id.org/holobiomicslab/asb-schema/v0.2</code> <span>License: CC-BY-4.0</span> </div>

ASB Standard v0.2: schema for scientific benchmark substrates and curated skill / tool release collections. Imports sub-schemas for ASB Cards, Capsules, Skill Bundles, Skill Collections, and the SkillCollectionRegistry.

Schema name `asb_standard`. Imports: `linkml:types`, [`asb_card.yaml`](#file-asb_card), [`asb_capsule.yaml`](#file-asb_capsule), [`asb_skill_bundle.yaml`](#file-asb_skill_bundle), [`asb_skill_collection.yaml`](#file-asb_skill_collection), [`asb_skill_collection_registry.yaml`](#file-asb_skill_collection_registry). Format page: [The format](../schema/index.md).

## asb_card.yaml { #file-asb_card }

<div class="asb-spec-meta"> <span class="asb-badge asb-badge--version">asb_card.yaml 0.2.0</span> <code>https://w3id.org/holobiomicslab/asb-schema/card/v0.2</code> <span>License: CC-BY-4.0</span> </div>

LinkML schema for SciTask Card v0.17.0: a bounded, reproducible scientific task extracted from a peer-reviewed paper. Covers all fields of the ASBTaskCard dataclass and related nested types.

Schema name `asb_card_v0_2`. Imports: `linkml:types`. Format page: [Task card](../schema/task-card.md).

### AvailableArtifact { #class-AvailableArtifact }

A file or data artifact accessible from the research paper package. Records its path, role in the workflow, whether it is indexable, and an optional content hash.

*Class of `asb_card.yaml`*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Slot | Range | Cardinality | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | 1 | Relative path to the artifact within the package | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `prov:atLocation` |
| `role` | `string` | 1 | Semantic role of the artifact (e.g. raw_data, figure, script) | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `dcterms:type` |
| `indexable` | `boolean` | 0..1 | Whether this artifact's content is indexed for retrieval | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `schema:additionalType` |
| `sha256` | `string` | 0..1 | SHA-256 hex digest of the artifact content | importance: nice_to_have; exact_mappings: `schema:sha256` |

</div>

*Class of `asb_card.yaml`*

| Slot | Range | Cardinality | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `direct_checks` | `string` | 0..* | List of automated, deterministic checks that can be run without human review (e.g., file existence, column count, value ranges). | importance: must_have; close_mappings: `pplan:Plan` |
| `expert_review` | `string` | 0..* | List of criteria requiring human or expert judgment (e.g., scientific validity, reproducibility within tolerance). | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `pplan:Plan` |

</div>

### ASBTaskCard { #class-ASBTaskCard }

A bounded, reproducible scientific task extracted from a peer-reviewed paper. Links a task to its research question, finding, inputs, outputs, tools, required skills, workflow description, and evaluation strategy. Runtime mirror: agentic_science_builder.schemas.ASBTaskCard (schema v0.18.0).

*Class of `asb_card.yaml`; tree root*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Slot | Range | Cardinality | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `task_id` | `string` | 1 | Unique identifier for this task (e.g. task_001 or doi-slug__task_001) | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `dcterms:identifier` |
| `title` | `string` | 1 | Short human-readable task title | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `schema:name` |
| `task_kind` | [`TaskKindEnum`](#enum-TaskKindEnum) | 0..1 | How this card relates to the source paper (reproduction of a reported result, derived analysis, reconstruction of a described mechanism, or an extension beyond the paper). Optional; absent means unclassified. | importance: nice_to_have; close_mappings: `dcterms:type` |
| `source_package` | `string` | 1 | Path or identifier of the research article package this card was synthesized from | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `prov:wasDerivedFrom` |
| `research_question` | `string` | 1 | The scientific question this task addresses | importance: must_have; close_mappings: `schema:description` |
| `finding` | `string` | 1 | The paper's answer or result for this task | importance: must_have; close_mappings: `schema:description` |
| `task_description` | `string` | 1 | Full natural-language description of the task | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `schema:description` |
| `task_objective` | `string` | 0..1 | One-sentence task objective (LLM mode; empty string when not populated) | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `pplan:Plan` |
| `inputs` | `string` | 1..* | Human-readable input descriptions for the task | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `pplan:wasGeneratedBy` |
| `expected_outputs` | `string` | 1..* | Human-readable expected output descriptions | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `pplan:wasGeneratedBy` |
| `tools` | `string` | 1..* | Software tools, databases, and APIs used in the task | importance: must_have; close_mappings: `EDAM:operation_0004` |
| `skills` | `string` | 1..* | Reusable capabilities required to complete the task | importance: must_have; close_mappings: `EDAM:operation_0004` |
| `workflow_description` | `string` | 1 | Step-by-step methodology for executing the task | importance: must_have; close_mappings: `pplan:Plan` |
| `available_artifacts` | [`AvailableArtifact`](#class-AvailableArtifact) | 0..* | Artifacts accessible from the paper package (path, role, indexable, sha256) | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `prov:atLocation` |
| `missing_information` | `string` | 0..* | Gaps, inaccessible artifacts, and unknowns noted by the extraction agent | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `schema:description` |
| `uncertainty_notes` | `string` | 0..* | Gaps and ambiguities in the card's fields | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `schema:description` |
| `evidence_snippets` | [`EvidenceSnippet`](#class-EvidenceSnippet) | 0..* | Verbatim text snippets from the source paper supporting this card | importance: should_have; exact_mappings: `prov:wasDerivedFrom` |
| `evaluation_strategy` | [`EvaluationStrategy`](#class-EvaluationStrategy) | 1 | Structured evaluation plan with direct_checks and expert_review lists, aligned with p-plan:Plan | importance: must_have; close_mappings: `pplan:Plan` |
| `review_questions` | `string` | 0..* | Open questions for a human reviewer of this card | importance: nice_to_have; close_mappings: `schema:description` |
| `created_at` | `string` | 1 | ISO 8601 timestamp when this card was created | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `dcterms:created` |
| `schema_version` | `string` | 1 | ASBTaskCard dataclass schema version (e.g. 0.17.0) | importance: must_have; close_mappings: `schema:version` |

### TaskKindEnum { #enum-TaskKindEnum }

What a SciTask Card represents relative to the source paper: a result the paper empirically reported, a derived re-analysis, a described-but-not- separately-validated mechanism, or a task beyond the paper's reported scope.

*Enumeration of `asb_card.yaml`*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `reproduction` | A result the paper empirically reported / evaluated |
| `analysis` | A derived re-analysis of the paper's own data |
| `component_reconstruction` | A mechanism the paper describes but does not separately validate (a stage of its pipeline, reconstructed as a checkable task) |
| `extension` | A task beyond the paper's reported scope (e.g. its sanctioned method substitutions or future work) |

</div>

### ReproducibilityTierEnum { #enum-ReproducibilityTierEnum }

Tier describing how reproducible a card's workflow step is

*Enumeration of `asb_card.yaml`*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `certified` | Fully automated and verified |
| `type-checked` | Outputs type-checked but not end-to-end verified |
| `bypassed` | Compute step bypassed; cached outputs pinned |
| `manual-only` | Requires manual or commercial software; no CLI alternative |
| `experimental` | Wet-lab or experimental step; pseudo-outputs only |

</div>

### SchedulerEnum { #enum-SchedulerEnum }

HPC / cluster scheduler

*Enumeration of `asb_card.yaml`*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `none` |  |
| `slurm` |  |
| `lsf` |  |
| `pbs` |  |
| `kubernetes` |  |

</div>

### ComputeTierEnum { #enum-ComputeTierEnum }

Compute requirement tier for task execution

*Enumeration of `asb_card.yaml`*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `trivial` |  |
| `light` |  |
| `medium` |  |
| `heavy` |  |
| `hpc` |  |

</div>

### ArtifactConfidenceEnum { #enum-ArtifactConfidenceEnum }

Detection confidence level for a typed artifact

*Enumeration of `asb_card.yaml`*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `high` | Magic-byte verified on disk file |
| `medium` | Prose regex only, no disk file |
| `low` | Heuristic inference |
| `none` | Detection failed: honest unknown |

</div>

### ArtifactDetectionMethodEnum { #enum-ArtifactDetectionMethodEnum }

Method used to detect artifact format

*Enumeration of `asb_card.yaml`*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |

## asb_capsule.yaml { #file-asb_capsule }

<div class="asb-spec-meta"> <span class="asb-badge asb-badge--version">asb_capsule.yaml 0.1.0</span> <code>https://w3id.org/holobiomicslab/asb-schema/capsule/v0.2</code> <span>License: CC-BY-4.0</span> </div>

LinkML schema for SciTask Capsule v0.1: an RO-Crate 1.1 + Workflow Run Profile 0.5 directory wrapping a SciTask Card with evidence, provenance, evaluation material, and embedded script chunks.

Schema name `asb_capsule_v0_2`. Imports: `linkml:types`, [`asb_card.yaml`](#file-asb_card). Format page: [Capsule](../schema/capsule.md).

### ArtifactProvenanceEntry { #class-ArtifactProvenanceEntry }

Provenance record for a single file in the capsule, recording how it was produced and where it was sourced from.

*Class of `asb_capsule.yaml`*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Slot | Range | Cardinality | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | 1 | Relative path to the file within the capsule directory | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `prov:atLocation` |
| `source` | [`ArtifactSourceEnum`](#enum-ArtifactSourceEnum) | 1 | Source agent or process that produced this file | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `prov:wasGeneratedBy` |
| `jsonpath` | `string` | 0..1 | JSONPath into the emitting agent's output locating this artifact | importance: nice_to_have; close_mappings: `prov:atLocation` |
| `created_at` | `string` | 0..1 | ISO 8601 timestamp when this artifact was produced | importance: should_have; exact_mappings: `dcterms:created` |

</div>

### SciTaskCapsule { #class-SciTaskCapsule }

An RO-Crate 1.1 + Workflow Run Profile 0.5 package that wraps a SciTask Card with supporting evidence, provenance, evaluation manifests, and embedded scripts. Conforms to schema:Dataset, rocrate:Dataset, and pplan:Plan.

*Class of `asb_capsule.yaml`; tree root*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Slot | Range | Cardinality | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `capsule_task_id` | `string` | 1 | Unique identifier for this capsule; typically doi-slug__task_NNN. Matches the task_id in the embedded ASBTaskCard. | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `dcterms:identifier` |
| `ro_crate_version` | `string` | 0..1 | RO-Crate specification version used (e.g. 1.1) | importance: must_have; close_mappings: `schema:version` |
| `profile_version` | `string` | 0..1 | Workflow Run Profile version used (e.g. 0.5) | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `schema:version` |
| `capsule_card` | [`ASBTaskCard`](#class-ASBTaskCard) | 1 | The SciTask Card embedded in this capsule | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `pplan:Plan` |
| `capsule_artifacts` | [`AvailableArtifact`](#class-AvailableArtifact) | 0..* | Artifacts accessible within this capsule | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `rocrate:Dataset` |
| `capsule_created_at` | `string` | 1 | ISO 8601 timestamp when this capsule was created | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `dcterms:created` |
| `artifact_provenance` | [`ArtifactProvenanceEntry`](#class-ArtifactProvenanceEntry) | 0..* | Provenance manifest for all files in the capsule | importance: should_have; exact_mappings: `prov:wasGeneratedBy` |
| `capsule_dir` | `string` | 0..1 | Relative or absolute path to the capsule directory on disk | importance: nice_to_have; exact_mappings: `prov:atLocation` |

</div>

Source agent or process that produced a file in the capsule

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `agent2b` | Card synthesizer (LLM-based Agent 2b) |
| `agent5` | Skill bundle synthesizer |
| `github_search` | GitHub search enricher |
| `perspicacite_mcp` | Perspicacite MCP enrichment |

## asb_skill_bundle.yaml { #file-asb_skill_bundle }

<div class="asb-spec-meta"> <span class="asb-badge asb-badge--version">asb_skill_bundle.yaml 0.2.0</span> <code>https://w3id.org/holobiomicslab/asb-schema/skill-bundle/v0.2</code> <span>License: CC-BY-4.0</span> </div>

LinkML schema for SciTask Skill Bundle v0.1: a versioned, curated description of one reusable computational skill identified across multiple papers. Each bundle contains a human-readable skill description and 12 structured sidecars.

Schema name `asb_skill_bundle_v0_2`. Imports: `linkml:types`. Format page: [Skill bundle](../schema/skill-bundle.md).

### ToolRecord { #class-ToolRecord }

A tool referenced in a Skill Bundle's tools.json sidecar.

*Class of `asb_skill_bundle.yaml`*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Slot | Range | Cardinality | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tool_name` | `string` | 1 | Tool name (e.g. matchms, scikit-learn) | importance: must_have; close_mappings: `EDAM:operation_0004` |
| `canonical_url` | `uri` | 0..1 | Canonical URL (GitHub, bio.tools, PyPI, etc.) | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `schema:codeRepository` |
| `version` | `string` | 0..1 | Version string used or recommended | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `schema:softwareVersion` |
| `tool_description` | `string` | 0..1 | Short description of the tool | importance: should_have; exact_mappings: `schema:description` |
| `edam_topics` | `uri` | 0..* | EDAM topic IRIs for this tool | importance: nice_to_have; exact_mappings: `EDAM:topic_0003` |

</div>

A reference to a source paper that contributed to this skill bundle.

*Class of `asb_skill_bundle.yaml`*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Slot | Range | Cardinality | Description | Notes |

| `doi` | `string` | 0..1 | DOI of the paper | importance: should_have; exact_mappings: `schema:identifier` |
| `title` | `string` | 0..1 | Title of the paper | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `schema:name` |
| `relevance` | `string` | 0..1 | Short note on the relevance of this paper to the skill | importance: nice_to_have; close_mappings: `schema:description` |
| `task_ids` | `string` | 0..* | task_id values from this paper that surfaced this skill | importance: nice_to_have; close_mappings: `dcterms:isPartOf` |

</div>

### MergeAuditRecord { #class-MergeAuditRecord }

Per-merge audit record documenting alias deduplication decisions. Surfaces the data ``corpus_artifacts._semantic_dedup`` already records so dedup decisions are queryable and citable (IDEAS-E / spec §11).

*Class of `asb_skill_bundle.yaml`*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Slot | Range | Cardinality | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `alias` | `string` | 1 | Original skill label before deduplication | importance: must_have; close_mappings: `schema:alternateName` |
| `target_slug` | `string` | 1 | Canonical slug this alias was merged into | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `schema:identifier` |
| `jaccard_score` | `float` | 0..1 | Token-set Jaccard similarity score used for the merge decision | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `schema:value` |
| `embedding_cosine` | `float` | 0..1 | Cosine similarity of MiniLM embeddings (when semantic dedup ran) | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `schema:value` |
| `edam_match` | `boolean` | 0..1 | True when both records share an EDAM operation IRI | importance: nice_to_have; close_mappings: `schema:sameAs` |
| `llm_judge_verdict` | `string` | 0..1 | Free-form judgement string from an LLM dedup judge (if used) | importance: nice_to_have; close_mappings: `schema:description` |
| `method` | `string` | 0..1 | Deduplication method (e.g. token_set_jaccard, semantic_embed, llm_judge) | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `prov:wasGeneratedBy` |
| `decision` | [`MergeDecisionEnum`](#enum-MergeDecisionEnum) | 1 | Final merge decision | importance: must_have; close_mappings: `prov:wasInfluencedBy` |
| `decided_at` | `datetime` | 0..1 | When the merge decision was recorded (ISO 8601) | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `prov:generatedAtTime` |
| `decided_by` | `string` | 0..1 | Agent or person that made the decision (e.g. "agent:dedup", "orcid:0000-...") | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `prov:wasAttributedTo` |

</div>

### SkillBundle { #class-SkillBundle }

A versioned, curated description of one reusable computational skill identified across multiple papers. Contains a human-readable skill description and 12 structured sidecars (papers, parameters, failure modes, tools, environments, links, etc.).

*Class of `asb_skill_bundle.yaml`; tree root*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Slot | Range | Cardinality | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slug` | `string` | 1 | Lowercase, hyphen-separated unique identifier for this skill bundle (e.g. spectral-similarity-scoring) | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `schema:identifier` |
| `skill_name` | `string` | 1 | Human-readable canonical name of the skill | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `schema:name` |
| `skill_description` | `string` | 0..1 | Full description of the skill's purpose and scope | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `schema:description` |
| `when_to_use` | `string` | 0..1 | Guidance on when and how to apply this skill | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `pplan:Plan` |
| `skill_tools` | [`ToolRecord`](#class-ToolRecord) | 0..* | Tool records for tools associated with this skill | importance: must_have; close_mappings: `EDAM:operation_0004` |
| `edam_topics` | `uri` | 0..* | EDAM topic IRIs for this skill (e.g. http://edamontology.org/topic_3172) | importance: should_have; exact_mappings: `EDAM:topic_0003` |
| `edam_operation` | `uri` | 0..1 | Primary EDAM operation IRI for this skill (e.g. http://edamontology.org/operation_3799) | importance: should_have; exact_mappings: `EDAM:operation_0004` |
| `scripts` | `string` | 0..* | Paths to embedded script chunks from linked GitHub repositories (line-range copies, not full clones) | importance: nice_to_have; exact_mappings: `prov:atLocation` |
| `skill_kb_path` | `string` | 0..1 | Relative path to the skill's knowledge base entry file (e.g. docs/skill_name.md) | importance: nice_to_have; exact_mappings: `prov:atLocation` |
| `bundle_dir` | `string` | 0..1 | Absolute path to the offline skill knowledge base bundle directory | importance: nice_to_have; exact_mappings: `prov:atLocation` |
| `bundle_version` | `string` | 1 | Version of this skill bundle (e.g. 0.1.0) | importance: must_have; close_mappings: `schema:version` |
| `source_task_ids` | `string` | 0..* | task_id values of the SciTask Cards from which this skill was extracted | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `dcterms:isPartOf` |
| `source_papers` | [`PaperReference`](#class-PaperReference) | 0..* | Structured references to papers that contributed to this bundle | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `dcterms:source` |
| `merged_aliases` | `string` | 0..* | Original labels of skills merged into this canonical entry | importance: nice_to_have; close_mappings: `schema:alternateName` |
| `merged_alias_records` | [`MergeAuditRecord`](#class-MergeAuditRecord) | 0..* | Per-merge audit records documenting alias deduplication decisions | importance: nice_to_have; close_mappings: `prov:wasGeneratedBy` |

</div>

Collection-time aggregated skill record: the deduplicated, paper-grounded scientific competency surfaced by ``corpus_artifacts.collect_skills`` at release time. Distinct from ``SkillBundle`` which is the per-capsule artifact. Mirrors the Python dataclass at agentic_science_builder.schemas.ASBSkill (renamed from SciSkill in Plan 2a / ASB-runtime).

*Class of `asb_skill_bundle.yaml`*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Slot | Range | Cardinality | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slug` | `string` | 1 | Lowercase, hyphen-separated unique identifier for this skill bundle (e.g. spectral-similarity-scoring) | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `schema:identifier` |
| `skill_name` | `string` | 1 | Human-readable canonical name of the skill | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `schema:name` |
| `description` | `string` | 1 | Retrieval-key description for an ASBSkill. Discipline-constrained (IDEAS-D / spec §5): 50 to 300 chars, leads with "Use when …", no marketing tokens. The CI gate in asb-skill-collections additionally enforces the banned-token list at release time. | pattern: `^[Uu]se when .+`; minimum_value: 50; maximum_value: 300; importance: must_have; banned_tokens: revolutionary, cutting-edge, best-in-class, powerful, amazing, state-of-the-art, groundbreaking; exact_mappings: `schema:description` |
| `when_to_use` | `string` | 0..1 | Guidance on when and how to apply this skill | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `pplan:Plan` |
| `related_tools` | `string` | 0..* | Canonical URLs / slugs of tools used by this skill | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `EDAM:operation_0004` |
| `source_task_ids` | `string` | 0..* | task_id values of the SciTask Cards from which this skill was extracted | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `dcterms:isPartOf` |
| `source_paper_doi` | `string` | 0..1 | Primary source paper DOI (flat field, complements source_papers[]) | importance: should_have; exact_mappings: `schema:identifier` |
| `source_paper_title` | `string` | 0..1 | Primary source paper title (flat field, complements source_papers[]) | importance: nice_to_have; exact_mappings: `schema:name` |
| `source_papers` | [`PaperReference`](#class-PaperReference) | 0..* | Structured references to papers that contributed to this bundle | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `dcterms:source` |
| `merged_aliases` | `string` | 0..* | Original labels of skills merged into this canonical entry | importance: nice_to_have; close_mappings: `schema:alternateName` |
| `merged_alias_records` | [`MergeAuditRecord`](#class-MergeAuditRecord) | 0..* | Per-merge audit records documenting alias deduplication decisions | importance: nice_to_have; close_mappings: `prov:wasGeneratedBy` |
| `edam_operation` | `uri` | 0..1 | Primary EDAM operation IRI for this skill (e.g. http://edamontology.org/operation_3799) | importance: should_have; exact_mappings: `EDAM:operation_0004` |
| `edam_topics` | `uri` | 0..* | EDAM topic IRIs for this skill (e.g. http://edamontology.org/topic_3172) | importance: should_have; exact_mappings: `EDAM:topic_0003` |
| `kb_path` | `string` | 0..1 | Relative path to the skill's knowledge-base entry file | importance: nice_to_have; exact_mappings: `prov:atLocation` |
| `bundle_dir` | `string` | 0..1 | Absolute path to the offline skill knowledge base bundle directory | importance: nice_to_have; exact_mappings: `prov:atLocation` |

</div>

## asb_skill_collection.yaml { #file-asb_skill_collection }

<div class="asb-spec-meta"> <span class="asb-badge asb-badge--version">asb_skill_collection.yaml 0.3.0</span> <code>https://w3id.org/holobiomicslab/asb-schema/skill-collection/v0.3</code> <span>License: CC-BY-4.0</span> </div>

LinkML schema for ASB SkillCollection: a curated thematic release containing N ASBSkills and M ASBTools, pinned by content-hash IRIs. Each SkillCollection release corresponds to one Zenodo concept DOI; releases mint version DOIs beneath that concept. v0.3 declares the ten keys every released collection.yaml already carries (JSON-LD framing, lead curators, counts, catalogue topics, attribution roles, Zenodo DOI), so a real manifest validates against the class instead of failing on additional properties. All ten are optional; the required set is unchanged.

Schema name `asb_skill_collection_v0_3`. Imports: `linkml:types`, [`asb_skill_bundle.yaml`](#file-asb_skill_bundle). Format page: [Skill collection](../schema/skill-collection.md).

### Any { #class-Any }

Unconstrained value. Used only for the inline JSON-LD `@context`, whose shape (IRI string, object or list) belongs to JSON-LD, not to this schema.

*Class of `asb_skill_collection.yaml`; class_uri: `linkml:Any`*

This class declares no slots or attributes.

### Person { #class-Person }

A person: contributor at the collection level (IDEAS-B / spec §16.3).

*Class of `asb_skill_collection.yaml`*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Slot | Range | Cardinality | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | 1 | Full display name | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `schema:name` |
| `orcid` | `uri` | 0..1 | ORCID iD as a URI (https://orcid.org/0000-0000-0000-0000) | importance: should_have; exact_mappings: `schema:identifier` |
| `affiliation` | `string` | 0..1 | Institutional affiliation (free-form; e.g. "Holobiomics Lab, CNRS") | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `schema:affiliation` |

</div>

### SkillCollection { #class-SkillCollection }

A curated thematic release of N ASBSkills and M ASBTools, pinned by content-hash. Distinct from per-capsule SkillBundle; this is the release unit (IDEAS-B / spec §3).

*Class of `asb_skill_collection.yaml`; tree root*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Slot | Range | Cardinality | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `iri` | `uriorcurie` | 1 | Stable IRI for this collection release (e.g. w3id.org/holobiomicslab/asb-skill/collection/metabolomics/v1). | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `schema:url` |
| `slug` | `string` | 1 | Short slug for the collection (e.g. "metabolomics") | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `schema:identifier` |
| `version` | `integer` | 1 | Release version number (integer; matches the vN in the IRI) | importance: must_have; close_mappings: `schema:version` |
| `title` | `string` | 1 | Human-readable collection title | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `schema:name` |
| `description` | `string` | 1 | Human-readable description of the collection's scope and thematic coherence | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `schema:description` |
| `license` | `string` | 1 | SPDX license identifier (e.g. "CC-BY-4.0") | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `schema:license` |
| `contributors` | [`Person`](#class-Person) | 0..* | People who curated this collection (per-collection ORCIDs; spec §16.3) | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `schema:contributor` |
| `doi` | `uriorcurie` | 0..1 | Zenodo DOI of this collection release (uriorcurie) | importance: should_have; exact_mappings: `schema:identifier` |
| `released_at` | `datetime` | 0..1 | Release timestamp (ISO 8601) | importance: should_have; exact_mappings: `schema:datePublished` |
| `skills` | `uriorcurie` | 0..* | Content-hash-pinned references to ASBSkill entries included in this release. Each entry is an IRI of the form w3id.org/holobiomicslab/asb-skill/&lt;slug&gt;@sha256:&lt;hash&gt; | importance: must_have; close_mappings: `dcterms:hasPart` |
| `tools` | `uriorcurie` | 0..* | Content-hash-pinned references to ASBTool entries used by this collection. Each entry is an IRI of the form w3id.org/holobiomicslab/asb-tool/&lt;slug&gt;@sha256:&lt;hash&gt; | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `dcterms:hasPart` |
| `edam_topics` | `uri` | 0..* | Collection-level EDAM topic IRIs (anchors the whole release) | importance: should_have; exact_mappings: `EDAM:topic_0003` |
| `source_collections` | `uriorcurie` | 0..* | Recursive: IRIs of prior collections this release is derived from (e.g. merged or split). Empty for fresh collections. | importance: nice_to_have; close_mappings: `prov:wasDerivedFrom` |
| `catalogue_membership` | `uriorcurie` | 0..* | Higher-level catalogue IRIs that include this collection (typically the SkillCollectionRegistry root). | importance: nice_to_have; close_mappings: `dcterms:isPartOf` |
| `ro_crate_path` | `string` | 0..1 | Path to this collection's ro-crate-metadata.json (relative to release root) | importance: should_have; exact_mappings: `prov:atLocation` |
| `jsonld_context` | [`Any`](#class-Any) | 0..1 | Inline JSON-LD context of the manifest. Serialised as `@context`; opaque to this schema. | alias (serialized key): `@context` |
| `jsonld_type` | `string` | 0..1 | JSON-LD type of the manifest node (e.g. asb:SkillCollection). Serialised as `@type`. | alias (serialized key): `@type` |
| `jsonld_id` | `uriorcurie` | 0..1 | JSON-LD node identifier; equal to `iri` in released manifests. Serialised as `@id`. | alias (serialized key): `@id` |
| `lead_curators` | [`Curator`](#class-Curator) | 0..* | Lead curators of the release (see Curator). | inlined_as_list: true |
| `skills_count` | `integer` | 0..1 | Number of skills the release declares; read by the catalogue generator. | minimum_value: 0 |
| `tools_count` | `integer` | 0..1 | Number of tools the release declares; read by the catalogue generator. | minimum_value: 0 |
| `workflows_count` | `integer` | 0..1 | Number of workflow directories the release ships, when declared; a release gate checks it against the tree. | minimum_value: 0 |
| `domain_topics` | `uri` | 0..* | EDAM topic IRIs under the name the catalogue generator reads. Released manifests carry the same list as `edam_topics`. | close_mappings: `schema:about` |
| `roles` | [`CollectionRoles`](#class-CollectionRoles) | 0..1 | Collection-level attribution roles (see CollectionRoles). | inlined: true |
| `zenodo_doi` | `string` | 0..1 | Bare Zenodo DOI of the deposit (10.5281/zenodo.N), as recorded by the Zenodo release step. Released manifests carry the same value as `doi`. | pattern: `^10\.5281/zenodo\.[0-9]+$` |

</div>

### Curator { #class-Curator }

A lead curator as released manifests record one: display name, a bare ORCID iD and a GitHub handle. Distinct from Person, whose `orcid` is a URI; the manifest writer derives `contributors` from this list with the URI form.

*Class of `asb_skill_collection.yaml`*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Slot | Range | Cardinality | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | 1 | Full display name | exact_mappings: `schema:name` |
| `orcid` | `string` | 0..1 | Bare ORCID iD (0000-0000-0000-0000), not a URI | pattern: `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{3}[0-9X]$` |
| `github` | `string` | 0..1 | GitHub user name |  |

</div>

### CollectionRoles { #class-CollectionRoles }

Attribution roles for the collection as a whole, mirroring the per-skill `attribution` block: what generated it, who promotes it, who paid for it, who curated it, and the author list deposited on Zenodo.

*Class of `asb_skill_collection.yaml`*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Slot | Range | Cardinality | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `generator` | `string` | 0..1 | What produced the content (a pipeline, not a human author) |  |
| `promoter` | `string` | 0..1 | Person who proposes the collection for use |  |
| `sponsor` | `string` | 0..1 | Who paid the generation cost |  |
| `curators` | `string` | 0..* | People who modified or validated the content (may be empty) |  |
| `zenodo_authors` | `string` | 0..* | Creators as listed on the Zenodo deposit, in order |  |

</div>

## asb_skill_collection_registry.yaml { #file-asb_skill_collection_registry }

<div class="asb-spec-meta"> <span class="asb-badge asb-badge--version">asb_skill_collection_registry.yaml 0.2.0</span> <code>https://w3id.org/holobiomicslab/asb-schema/skill-collection-registry/v0.2</code> <span>License: CC-BY-4.0</span> </div>

LinkML schema for the asb-skill-collections catalogue root. Lists all published SkillCollection releases and reserves an `external_repos` slot for future federation (IDEAS-I / spec §9.2). The serialized form is `catalogue.jsonld` at the root of the `asb-skill-collections` repo.

Schema name `asb_skill_collection_registry_v0_2`. Imports: `linkml:types`, [`asb_skill_collection.yaml`](#file-asb_skill_collection). Format page: [Skill collection](../schema/skill-collection.md#collection-registry).

### SkillCollectionRegistry { #class-SkillCollectionRegistry }

Catalogue root for the `asb-skill-collections` repo. Lists every released SkillCollection, plus a reserved (v1-off) federation slot.

*Class of `asb_skill_collection_registry.yaml`; tree root*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Slot | Range | Cardinality | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `registry_iri` | `uriorcurie` | 1 | Stable IRI of this registry (e.g. w3id.org/holobiomicslab/asb-skill/) | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `schema:url` |
| `registry_title` | `string` | 1 | Human-readable registry title | importance: must_have; exact_mappings: `schema:name` |
| `registry_description` | `string` | 0..1 | Human-readable description of the registry | importance: should_have; exact_mappings: `schema:description` |
| `registry_maintainers` | [`Person`](#class-Person) | 0..* | People listed in MAINTAINERS.md who curate this registry | importance: should_have; close_mappings: `schema:contributor` |
| `collections` | `uriorcurie` | 1..* | IRIs of all SkillCollection releases catalogued by this registry. Each entry pins a specific version (e.g. w3id.org/holobiomicslab/asb-skill/collection/metabolomics/v1). | importance: must_have; close_mappings: `dcterms:hasPart` |
| `external_repos` | `uriorcurie` | 0..* | RESERVED (off in v1). Future federation slot: IRIs of third-party `*-skill-collections` repos whose collections get aggregated into this catalogue. Per spec §9.2 and §15, this is a design slot only. | importance: nice_to_have; close_mappings: `dcterms:isPartOf` |
| `generated_at` | `datetime` | 0..1 | When this catalogue snapshot was generated (ISO 8601) | importance: should_have; exact_mappings: `prov:generatedAtTime` |

</div>

## asb_trace.yaml { #file-asb_trace }

<div class="asb-spec-meta"> <span class="asb-badge asb-badge--version">asb_trace.yaml 0.1.0</span> <code>https://w3id.org/holobiomicslab/asb-schema/trace/v0.1</code> <span>License: CC-BY-4.0</span> </div>

LinkML schema for the ASB exploration trace v0.1.0: the research journey behind a paper's outcome: what was asked, tried, chosen and rejected. ASB's existing card and capsule schemas are outcome-only; this records the branches, including the ones that failed. Mirrors the ExplorationNode / ExplorationTree dataclasses in agentic_science_builder.trace_extract.model.

Schema name `asb_trace_v0_1`. Imports: `linkml:types`. Format page: [Exploration trace](../schema/exploration-trace.md).

### ExplorationNode { #class-ExplorationNode }

One step in the research journey. The value of `type` selects which further slots are mandatory; those constraints are enforced by agentic_science_builder.trace_extract.gate, not expressible in LinkML alone.

*Class of `asb_trace.yaml`*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Slot | Range | Cardinality | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | 1 | N-prefixed, zero-padded node identifier, unique within the tree | identifier: true; pattern: `^N\d{2,}$` |
| `type` | [`NodeTypeEnum`](#enum-NodeTypeEnum) | 1 | Kind of step |  |
| `title` | `string` | 1 | Short human-readable label for the step |  |
| `support_level` | [`SupportLevelEnum`](#enum-SupportLevelEnum) | 1 | Whether the source stated this step or it was reconstructed |  |
| `source_refs` | `string` | 0..* | Where in the source this step is stated, e.g. "§4.1", "Table 2", "Fig. 6 left". Mandatory when support_level is explicit. |  |
| `children` | [`ExplorationNode`](#class-ExplorationNode) | 0..* | Nested steps that follow from this one | inlined_as_list: true |
| `also_depends_on` | `string` | 0..* | Cross-edges to nodes outside this node's nesting, making the tree a DAG |  |
| `choice` | `string` | 0..1 | The option taken (decision nodes) | slot_uri: `pplan:Plan` |
| `alternatives` | `string` | 0..* | Options considered and not taken (decision nodes). A decision with no alternative is a restatement, not a decision. |  |
| `alternatives_unanchored` | `integer` | 0..1 | How many alternatives a guard removed from this decision (decision nodes); set only when at least one was removed, so an empty alternatives list beside a positive count is a recorded gap rather than a decision the source never qualified. The removed text is deliberately not recorded. |  |
| `hypothesis` | `string` | 0..1 | What the abandoned approach assumed (dead_end nodes) |  |
| `failure_mode` | `string` | 0..1 | How the abandoned approach failed (dead_end nodes) |  |
| `lesson` | `string` | 0..1 | What a later reader should take from the failure (dead_end nodes). This is the field that stops a downstream agent re-walking the same branch. |  |
| `result` | `string` | 0..1 | What the attempt produced (experiment nodes) |  |
| `evidence` | `string` | 0..* | Claim ids, figures or tables supporting the result (experiment nodes) |  |
| `from` | `string` | 0..1 | The approach departed from (pivot nodes) |  |
| `to` | `string` | 0..1 | The approach moved to (pivot nodes) |  |
| `trigger` | `string` | 0..1 | What prompted the change of direction (pivot nodes) |  |

</div>

### ExplorationTree { #class-ExplorationTree }

A paper's exploration graph: root nodes plus everything nested beneath.

*Class of `asb_trace.yaml`*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Slot | Range | Cardinality | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | `string` | 1 | Version of this trace schema |  |
| `source_doi` | `string` | 0..1 | DOI of the paper whose journey this trace records | slot_uri: `prov:wasDerivedFrom` |
| `nodes` | [`ExplorationNode`](#class-ExplorationNode) | 0..* | Root nodes of the exploration graph | inlined_as_list: true |

</div>

### NodeTypeEnum { #enum-NodeTypeEnum }

Kind of step in the research journey

*Enumeration of `asb_trace.yaml`*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `question` | An open question, typically the root of a branch |
| `experiment` | An attempt that produced a result |
| `decision` | A choice made between competing options |
| `dead_end` | An approach tried and abandoned; always a leaf |
| `pivot` | A change of direction from one approach to another |

</div>

### SupportLevelEnum { #enum-SupportLevelEnum }

Whether the source stated this step outright or it was reconstructed. The honesty axis: an inferred node must never be presented as directly observed.

*Enumeration of `asb_trace.yaml`*

<div class="asb-ref" markdown>

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `explicit` | Stated in the source; requires source_refs |
| `inferred` | Reconstructed from surrounding narrative |

</div>
